templates.label: Plan
templates.condition: Create a concise implementation plan for {scope}. Identify the files, sequence, risks, and verification needed before changing code.

templates.label: Build
templates.condition: Implement {scope} using the repository's existing patterns. Keep edits scoped, update nearby tests, and preserve unrelated work.

templates.label: Debug
templates.condition: Debug {scope}. Reproduce the failure, capture evidence, isolate the root cause, add a regression test where practical, and implement the smallest fix.

templates.label: Validate
templates.condition: Validate {scope}. Run the relevant tests, typechecks, builds, or UI checks; inspect failures; and fix regressions until the verification set is clean.

templates.label: Typecheck
templates.condition: Typecheck {scope}. Find the repository's relevant typecheck command, run it, fix type errors without broad refactors, and re-run until clean.

templates.label: Commit
templates.condition: Prepare a commit for {scope}. Review the diff, ensure verification has passed, stage only relevant files, and write a concise conventional commit message.

templates.label: Fix lint
templates.description: Fix all lint errors in the project
templates.condition: the lint command exits with code 0

templates.label: Pass tests
templates.condition: the test command exits with code 0 with no failing tests

templates.label: Codex electron smoke template
templates.description: the test command exits with code 0 with no failing tests
templates.condition: the test command exits with code 0 with no failing tests
